summary.para: An index is overdue when it has passed its frozen_after age by more than the configured threshold and has not yet completed its transition to the frozen tier. Indices with a running transition are making progress and are not counted as overdue.
Indicates whether a default snapshot repository is configured with the repositories.default_repository cluster setting.
The time, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, when the master node generated the health snapshot. Only present when the indicator status is unknown, meaning the health snapshot is stale.
The total number of overdue indices in the cluster.
The number of overdue indices in the cluster for each transition state. Only present when there are overdue indices.

A sample of the overdue indices and their transition states, sorted by index name. The sample is limited to 100 indices for each transition state, so it can contain fewer indices than overdue_indices_count. Only present when there are overdue indices.
Indicates whether the frozen transition service is running on the current master node.
Indicates whether frozen-tier transitions are enabled by the dlm.frozen_transitions.enabled cluster setting.
